title: ConditionParameter
description: Vendor-neutral condition-monitoring parameter contract, aligned with the pi-collector attribute registry. Breaking v2 (2026-08): renamed id->attribute_id, name->business_name, parameter_type->parameter; added site, unit (plant unit), unit_of_measure (engineering unit), equipment, is_active, registered_at. Pre-v2 had no consumers. Verified via pi-collector load-registry from pi-knowledge mappings (site BSR, unit BSR1).

unit.description: Plant / generating unit, e.g. BSR1. NOT the engineering unit (see unit_of_measure)

equipment.description: Equipment group name from pi-knowledge registry, e.g. BSR1.Turbine

unit_of_measure.description: Engineering unit abbreviation, e.g. degC, bar, RPM

is_active.description: Soft-active flag; set false on 410 Gone or upstream prune

pi.description: PI identifiers; only web_id is read from PI, af_path is synthesized locally as 'site > unit > equipment > name'

web_id.description: PI Web API WebId, sourced from verified pi-knowledge entries only

af_path.description: Locally synthesized AF hierarchy path (not read from PI)
